request.query:
Why do I receive the message, "IKJ79154I INSTALLATION EXIT IKJEESX0 REQUESTED TERMINATION. " for a TSO SEND command?
If you issue the TSO SEND command in a batch job and receive this message:

IKJ79154I INSTALLATION EXIT IKJEESX0 REQUESTED TERMINATION.
IKJ79154I REASON CODE X'00000004'.

source_lineage.excerpt: Code the appropriate security definitions for FEK.CMD.SEND and FEK.CMD.SEND.CLEAR.

IMP2       00000010  0000400C  Invalid cmd for XRF alternate
      IMP1       00000004  00001000  IMS not master, cmd ignored
   
   Response for: QUERY OLC LIBRARY(OLCSTAT) SHOW(ALL)
   MbrName    CC Library    ACBLIB   FMTLIB  MODBLKS  Modid DSName
   ---------------------------------------------------------------
   IMP5        0 OLCSTAT         A        A        A      0 IMS10P
   
   =============================
   
   New Function for CSLOMCMD/CSLOMI APIs, TSO SPOC (DFSSPOC), Batch
   SPOC (CSLUSPOC), REXX SPOC API
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   A new enhancement is being introduced with this maintenance that
   allows the user to specify ROUTE=% as it pertains to the routing
   of a command to command processing clients within the IMSplex.
   
   When ROUTE=% is specified, OM routes the command to the first

When ROUTE=% is specified, OM routes the command to the first
   command processing client which is READY and has MASTER
   capability.  With ROUTE=%, OM routes the command to only one
   command processing client that OM chooses.

CICS was issued.
   2. DFSCTER0 was invoked to perform the signon.  DFSCTER0
   called a signon exit DFSCSGN0.
   3. DFSCSGN0 rejected the signon, set up R15 with a negative
   value x'FFFFFC70' as a complemented value of a user defined
   message number x'390' (912).
   4. DFSCTER0 set a reason code of 100 (x'64') upon returning
   to the caller.
   5. The ISC TCP/IP DDM logic failed to detect this negative
   value in R15, issued MSGDFS3595E RETCODE=FFFFFC70, RSNCODE=
   00000064.

*  GEN:
   KEYWORDS:
   
   *** END IMS KEYWORDS ***
   DFSCT7B0 has been modified at entry 1 and 3 to detect a
   negative value in R15 upon returning from DFSTSEC0 to
   issue a user defined message.
   
   DFSCTER0 has been modified to handle the user defined
   message.
   
   Document change:
   ---------------
   GC19-4240-01
   IMS Version 13
     Messages and Codes, Volume 1: DFS Messages
   
   DFS3596E
   ISC TCPIP DETECTED AN ERROR,active_process, RETCODE = rc,
   RSNCODE = rsn, LOSTSESS = cause, MODULE = mod_name, NODE =
   nodename, USER = username
   
   Explanation:
   The ISC TCP/IP device dependent module (DDM) detected an error
   while processing a message or request associated with the ISC
   parallel session identified in the message.
   
   In the message text:
   active_process
   
   SENDACK
     When ISC TCP/IP encountered the error , ISC was attempting

*  Change the TSO PREFIX or batch job userid to something other
   than JOBxxxxx.
